title: Editable user profile (display name) in chayan frontend

requirements.summary: Add an in-app Edit profile dialog to update the signed-in user’s display name and reflect it immediately across the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: The header user dropdown includes an 'Edit profile' action.
Selecting 'Edit profile' opens a dialog with an editable display name field and Save/Cancel actions (English UI text).
Saving updates the display name via the backend and updates the displayed name in the header without requiring a full page refresh.
Validation prevents saving an empty/whitespace-only display name and shows a clear error message in English.
If the backend update fails, the UI shows an error message in English and leaves the previous display name unchanged.

file_operations.description: Create an EditProfileDialog component that uses shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button (and optionally Alert) to edit the display name with Save/Cancel, client-side validation (non-empty/trim), and English error messaging; on Save call the backend updateDisplayName capability and invoke an onSaved callback to update UI state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an 'Edit profile' action to the existing header dropdown (using shadcn-ui DropdownMenuItem) that opens EditProfileDialog; wire dialog open/close state and pass the current displayName plus an onSaved handler so the header updates immediately after success. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Plumb a displayName update callback from ChatLayout into ChayanHeader (or let ChayanHeader trigger an onDisplayNameUpdated callback) so successful profile edits update the shared displayName state without a full refresh, and failures keep the previous displayName unchanged.

requirements.summary: On authenticated app load, fetch the caller’s profile; only register a default profile when none exists, and reuse the stored displayName on subsequent sign-ins.
acceptanceCriteria: On app load after authentication, the app attempts to fetch the caller’s profile from the backend.
If a profile exists, the UI uses the stored displayName instead of regenerating a new default name.
If no profile exists, the app registers the user once with a default display name and generated encryption key material, then uses that display name in the UI.
Repeated sign-ins do not create or overwrite the profile when it already exists.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook that, once an authenticated actor is available, loads the caller profile via backend getCallerProfile; if none exists, generates a default displayName and encryption key material and saves once via saveCallerProfile, then returns the resolved profile for UI use. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the current always-generate-and-register behavior with initialization that uses the new useCurrentUserProfile hook: (1) fetch profile after auth, (2) if present set displayName from profile, (3) if absent create default profile once via saveCallerProfile and set displayName accordingly, ensuring repeated sign-ins do not overwrite an existing profile.

Ensure the header renders the displayName coming from the fetched/initialized profile state so the stored name is shown consistently after sign-in and after edits. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
